archive: Daily and monthly Spot archives document aggTrades, klines, and trades.
Spot archive timestamps from 2025-01-01 use microseconds.
Each ZIP has an adjacent SHA-256 sidecar and Binance may later replace archive files.
The retained manifest therefore binds URL, sidecar, advertised digest, recomputed digest, member name, and byte size.
liveStreams: aggTrade is aggregated for a single taker order and carries aggregate ID plus first and last raw trade IDs.
trade is one raw buyer-seller match.
bookTicker is a real-time best-bid and best-ask update, not a contiguous depth chain.
Diff-depth replay requires snapshot bridging and update-range continuity; gaps require restart.
filters: exchangeInfo is point-in-time current data, not historical archive data.
PRICE_FILTER, PERCENT_PRICE, PERCENT_PRICE_BY_SIDE, LOT_SIZE, MARKET_LOT_SIZE, MIN_NOTIONAL, and NOTIONAL are distinct constraints.
Percent-price filters require a current reference price or documented rolling weighted average.
Archive klines cannot establish every point-in-time live order-admission rule.
fees: Exact commissions are symbol and account specific USER_DATA with standard, special, tax, and discount components.
Public 10 and 12 basis-point values are scenarios only; account-effective fees remain UNKNOWN.
